scope: Module-level causal-row trace and one independent-op replay. No generation, draft model, rollback, timing or automatic bug verdict.

operator_probe.note: CPU FP64 is a numerical reference, not proof of correct rounding. A shape difference alone does not establish a backend bug. Inputs are restored contiguously; original trace strides are recorded separately.

causal_check.note: Only interpret swaps if self controls preserve logits. A changed winner establishes a causal contribution under that intervention; an unchanged winner means the first difference alone was insufficient. Later operators can introduce additional drift. Neither result alone proves or excludes a backend correctness bug.
